summary_1line: After hearing of Khara’s death, Ravana considers abducting Sita, but Maricha warns him that provoking Rama will bring ruin.

image_candidates.scene_text: Maricha stands before the ten-headed Ravana in his court, warning him with raised hand while the demon king broods on a jeweled throne.
Maricha compares Rama to a mighty elephant and lion, gesturing dramatically as Ravana listens in the golden halls of Lanka.
